aaa_component_disagreement.interpretation: Raw measured components and rank disagreement only. Strong pitch traits do not imply starter volume, health, availability, future MLB innings, or opportunity. No missing component is zero-filled; every measurement remains separate.
aaa_component_disagreement.snapshot_policy: Promotion and demotion are distinct dated observations; this snapshot infers no direction, transaction date, reason, or pre/post split.

partial_category_best_season_impact.limitation: Uses only the available historical fantasy categories; it is not direct 7x7 realized value.
